{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667255571,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"0OI9r0KoxjJlNvar","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m0_plan.py","content":"# Compare options for Months 0..7\n# Available now:\n# M0: 10k H + 2k reserved = 12kH\n# M1..4: 10k H + min(1.43k if vendor ships, or more if power energises) + 2k reserved\n# M5..7: 10k H + (up to 4k H if power energises) + 0 reserved\n\n# Suppose we reserve 3 kH in M0 (assuming tight cap = 3 kH), 12-month at $1.60M/mo -> starts M1..M12\n# Then capacity from existing + queued (assuming 16 MW -> 11.43k H until new power energises) + 3k reserved:\n# M0: 12.00\n# M1: 11.43 + 2 + 3 = 16.43 (if 1.43k ships at end of M0)\n# M2: 11.43 + 2 + 3 = 16.43\n# M3: 11.43 + 2 + 3 = 16.43 (more if power energises at M3)\n# M4: 11.43 + 2 + 3 = 16.43\n# M5: 11.43 + 0 + 3 = 14.43 (or 14.0 + 3 = 17.0 if new power energised by M5!)\n# M6: 14.0 + 3 = 17.0 (if new power energised)\n# M7: 14.0 + 3 = 17.0\n\n# Wait: what if we ALSO reserve another 3 kH in M1 (starts M2..M13)?\n# Let's sum M0..M7 with 3k reserved in M0 (starts M1):\ncap_no_new_power_after_m5 = 12.0 + 4*16.43 + 3*14.43\ncap_with_power_m5 = 12.0 + 4*16.43 + 3*17.0\nprint(\"M0..7 total with 3k reserved in M0, no power by M5:\", cap_no_new_power_after_m5)\nprint(\"M0..7 total with 3k reserved in M0, power by M5:\", cap_with_power_m5)\nprint(\"Target M0..7: 113.4 (if 3% inf) to 121.6 (if 7% inf)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m0_plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m0_plan.py","time":{"start":1794667255549,"end":1794667255559}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da8116f5001pr8vkucr8ycTyn","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da808bcb0015yXZM7v1s3Jqf7"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667336635,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"DysgRn6yIfyuaPfa","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/res_compare.py","content":"# Compare 24m ($1.44/mo for 1..24, 23 useful months) vs 12m ($1.60/mo for 1..12) + re-contracting in 13..23\ncost_24m = 1.44 * 24 # $34.56M\ncost_12m = 1.60 * 12 # $19.20M\ndiff = cost_24m - cost_12m\nprint(f\"24m total: ${cost_24m:.2f}M; 12m total: ${cost_12m:.2f}M; diff for months 13..23 (11 mos): ${diff:.2f}M = ${diff/11:.3f}M/useful-mo\")\n\n# What will 12m contract index be in Month 12 (to cover months 13..23 or 13..24)?\n# Remember: at Gen N launch (m 11..18), contract index drops 25%!\n# Tight drift: +4%/mo; Loose drift: -2.5%/mo\nfor desc, drift in [(\"All tight (+4%/mo)\", 1.04), (\"50/50 (+0.7%/mo)\", 1.007), (\"All loose (-2.5%/mo)\", 0.975)]:\n    idx_m12_no_launch = 1.60 * (drift ** 12)\n    idx_m12_launched = idx_m12_no_launch * 0.75\n    print(f\"  {desc}: M12 index if not launched=${idx_m12_no_launch:.2f}M, if launched=${idx_m12_launched:.2f}M\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/res_compare.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/res_compare.py","time":{"start":1794667336604,"end":1794667336619}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da825388001MqzjOure4Q1E82","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da81f0b40019elqdxGAnL2FmY"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667385174,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"tnfOU0DWEbi9Jirw","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_m0.py","content":"# Check cash and capacity timeline for Month 0 decisions\n# Initial: 10k H, 4k H queued (m-2), 16 MW power (m-4..19), 2k cloud (m-7..4), $400M cash\n# Suppose M0:\n# - buy_gpus 8 H vendor ($200M) -> total H = 10 + 4 + 8 = 22k H\n# - buy_gpus 1 H A ($27.5M) -> +1k H if delivers\n# - reserve 4 24 -> gets min(4, cap) = 3 kH if tight, 4 if loose, at $1.44M/mo (starts M1)\n# - contract_power 12 + contract_power 10 (total 22 MW -> total 38 MW with existing 16 MW)\n#   38 MW powers 27.1k H!\n\n# Let's check cash after M0 actions:\ncash = 400 - 200 - 27.5\n# End of M0 monthly charges:\n# Power: 16 * 0.15 = 2.4\n# Existing contract: 2 * 2.0 = 4.0\n# Funding: +40\ncash_m1 = cash - 2.4 - 4.0 + 40\nprint(f\"Cash after M0 orders: ${cash:.1f}M; Cash at start of M1: ${cash_m1:.1f}M\")\n\n# Suppose tight allocation 2k/mo, no EC:\n# M0 end: 2k of initial 4k ships -> usable M1 (12k H powered by 16 MW? 11.43k H powered)\n# M1 end: 2k of initial 4k ships -> usable M2 (14k H, 11.43k powered unless new power energised)\n# M2 end: 2k of new 8k ships -> usable M3\n# M3 end: 2k of new 8k ships -> usable M4\n# M4 end: 2k of new 8k ships -> usable M5\n# M5 end: 2k of new 8k ships -> usable M6 -> all 22k H delivered!\n# Plus 1k Broker A usable M2 -> 23k H!\n# Cash inflow is +40M/mo, outflow ~2.4 + 3*1.44 + 3.3 = ~10M/mo -> +30M/mo cash accumulation!\n# By M11 (earliest Gen N launch), cash ~ 208 + 10*30 = $508M! Plenty of cash for Gen N!\n\n# Wait: what about capacity in M0..7 and M8..15?\n# Suppose power energises at M5.\n# Capacity with 3k (M1..24) + 3k reserved in M1 (M2..25 or M2..13):\ncap_m = []\nfor m in range(8):\n    if m == 0:\n        h_pow = 10.0\n        res = 2.0\n    elif m == 1:\n        h_pow = 11.43\n        res = 2.0 + 3.0\n    elif m == 2:\n        h_pow = 11.43\n        res = 2.0 + 3.0 + 3.0\n    elif m in (3, 4):\n        h_pow = 11.43\n        res = 2.0 + 3.0 + 3.0\n    elif m == 5:\n        h_pow = 20.0 # if delivered 20k + 1k broker\n        res = 6.0\n    elif m == 6:\n        h_pow = 22.0\n        res = 6.0\n    elif m == 7:\n        h_pow = 23.0\n        res = 6.0\n    cap_m.append(h_pow + res)\nprint(\"M0..7 monthly capacity:\", cap_m, \"sum=\", sum(cap_m))\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_m0.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/sim_m0.py","time":{"start":1794667385129,"end":1794667385157}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da83111c001mcx3BTGEAPGYP6","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da82a8a50013NBpf8H8AP1gcY"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667808090,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"WdwaTf47ZqLx97p3","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Month 1 analysis: Gen N launches at Month 11 or 12!\n# Let's see how much capacity we need in M8..15 and M16..23!\n# Currently:\n# - 11.95k H delivered, 2.05k (#1) + 8k (#2) in vendor queue = 22k H (+1k Broker A = 23k H)\n# - Power: 16 MW (-4..19), 12 MW (5..28), 10 MW (7..30) -> 38 MW total in M7..19 (powers 27.1k H)\n# - Cloud: 2k (-7..4), 3k (1..24)\n\n# Suppose inference starts at 6.25 in M0 (wait: 6.25 could be 6.0 * ~1.04 noise, or 6.0 * 1.03/1.07).\n# Worst-case 7% growth from 6.0 (or 6.25):\nfor r_name, r in [(\"3%\", 1.03), (\"7%\", 1.07)]:\n    inf = [6.25 * (r ** m) for m in range(24)]\n    print(f\"Inf {r_name} from 6.25:\")\n    print(f\"  M1..7  sum={sum(inf[1:8]):.1f}\")\n    print(f\"  M8..15 sum={sum(inf[8:16]):.1f}, avg={sum(inf[8:16])/8:.2f}\")\n    print(f\"  M16..23 sum={sum(inf[16:24]):.1f}, avg={sum(inf[16:24])/8:.2f}\")\n\n# In M8..15, with 22k H + 3k cloud = 25k kH/mo = 200 kH-months!\n# Target in M8..15 = 140 (training) + 70..108 (inf) = 210..248 kH-months!\n# Deficit in M8..15 (if no more H/cloud/spot/N) = 10..48 kH-months = 1.25..6.0 kH/month!\nprint(\"\\nWith 22k H + 3k cloud = 25 kH/mo -> 200 kH-months in M8..15.\")\nprint(\"Need 210 (3%) to 248 (7%) kH-months in M8..15 -> short 10 to 48 kH-months!\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m1_plan.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m1_plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m1_plan.py","time":{"start":1794667806729,"end":1794667806927}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da897ecb001zzgR2Sg4VssSNf","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da8433760013vcm1B99d4XRoz"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794667961881,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"ccZ7EtxPri9kPu5d","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\n\nobs = [6.25, 7.58, 7.30, 6.68]\n# Check log-likelihood under 3% vs 7% assuming start=6.0 (or 6.0..6.5) and multiplicative noise N(1, 0.05) or N(1, 0.08)\nfor s in [6.0, 6.2, 6.4]:\n    for r in [1.03, 1.07]:\n        preds = [s * (r ** m) for m in range(4)]\n        errs = [(obs[m] / preds[m] - 1.0) for m in range(4)]\n        sse = sum(e*e for e in errs)\n        print(f\"start={s}, r={r}: preds={[round(x,2) for x in preds]}, rel_errs={[round(e*100,1) for e in errs]}, sse={sse:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/inf_check.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/inf_check.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/inf_check.py","time":{"start":1794667961864,"end":1794667961873}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da8bde00001ZjcM0fnnxJI6yS","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da8ab027001ckfkOQW9ZtwLUA"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668297774,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"HwXjAJK04OZlRSAe","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m8_plan.py","content":"# Compare capacity options at Month 8 (Gen N launches Month 12!)\n# 1. Cloud 12m reserved NOW at M8 ($2.046M/mo, M9..20 -> ALL 12 months useful!):\n#    Cost = $2.046M / kH-month.\n#    Wait: what if we wait until Month 12 (when Gen N launches and cloud prices drop 25%)?\n#    Suppose tight continues M8..11 (+4%/mo * 4 = 1.17x): 2.046 * 1.17 = $2.39M * 0.75 (launch drop) = $1.795M/mo at M12!\n#    Even if all 4 mos +6%/mo: 2.046 * 1.26 * 0.75 = $1.93M/mo!\n#    And if any loose months happen, even cheaper ($1.40-$1.70M/mo)!\n#    HOWEVER, in tight supply we can only reserve 3 kH/month!\n#    Let's check how much cloud + Gen N we can get starting M12 for M16..23!\n\n# Suppose in M16..23 we need 512 kH-months = 64 kH/month (if 7% continues) or 445 = 55.6 kH/mo (if switches to 3%):\n# Base by M15:\n# - 27k Gen H (powered if we replace 16 MW at M20!)\n# - 3 kH cloud (M1..24)\n# - 3 kH cloud (M8..19 -> expires after M19! Need replacement in M20..23!)\n# - Vendor Gen N ordered M12..20 (usable M15..23):\n#   If tight (1.5k N/mo = 3 kH/mo):\n#     M15: 3 kH\n#     M16: 6 kH\n#     M17: 9 kH\n#     M18: 12 kH\n#     M19: 15 kH\n#     M20: 18 kH\n#     M21: 21 kH\n#     M22: 24 kH\n#     M23: 27 kH\n#   Avg Vendor Gen N in M16..23 = (6+9+12+15+18+21+24+27)/8 = 16.5 kH/mo!\n# Total in M16..23 with ONLY 27k H + 3k cloud (M1..24) + 3k cloud (M8..19) + Vendor N (tight):\n#   27*8 + 3*8 + 3*4 + 16.5*8 = 216 + 24 + 12 + 132 = 384 kH-months!!\n#   SHORT by 512 - 384 = 128 kH-months (16 kH/month) if 7% inference continues!!\n#   (Even if switches to 3%, 445 - 384 = 61 kH-months SHORT!)\n\nprint(\"M16..23 capacity with 27k H + 2 existing clouds + Vendor N (tight 3kH/mo): 384 kH-mo\")\nprint(\"Target M16..23: 445 (if switches to 3%) to 512 (if stays 7%) -> SHORT 61 to 128 kH-months!!\")\nprint(\"WAIT: If we only get 3 kH/mo new cloud when tight, starting at M12 (M13..24) only adds 3 kH/mo per month of reserving!\")\nprint(\"Let's check: how many months of 3 kH reservations from M12..15? 4 months * 3 kH = +12 kH -> +96 kH-mo!\")\nprint(\"Still short ~32 kH-mo UNLESS we also use Broker A/B for Gen N (or loose months happen, or spot, or reserve 1-2 more clouds before M12)!\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m8_plan.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m8_plan.py","time":{"start":1794668297766,"end":1794668297771}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da90fe22001ROqsm0bJw0qm1H","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da90c2ba001JwPBp9saa69lDg"}}

Minus ~13-15 inf = ~23-25 training/mo!\n# So Run 2 finishes by M14 easily!\n\n# Training Run 3 (M16..23): needs 320 training + inference!\n# Let's check inference M16..23 under BOTH 7% (no switch) and 3% (switched at M11):\ninf_7 = [12.03 * (1.07 ** (m - 11)) for m in range(12, 24)]\ninf_3 = [12.03 * (1.03 ** (m - 11)) for m in range(12, 24)]\nprint(\"Inf M16..23 if 7%:\", [round(x,1) for x in inf_7[4:]], \"sum=\", round(sum(inf_7[4:]),1), \"avg=\", round(sum(inf_7[4:])/8,2))\nprint(\"Inf M16..23 if 3%:\", [round(x,1) for x in inf_3[4:]], \"sum=\", round(sum(inf_3[4:]),1), \"avg=\", round(sum(inf_3[4:])/8,2))\nprint(\"Total M16..23 capacity needed: if 7% ->\", round(320 + sum(inf_7[4:]), 1), f\"({(320+sum(inf_7[4:]))/8:.1f}/mo)\")\nprint(\"Total M16..23 capacity needed: if 3% ->\", round(320 + sum(inf_3[4:]), 1), f\"({(320+sum(inf_3[4:]))/8:.1f}/mo)\")\n\n# Check what we get in M16..23 from:\n# - 29k H (assuming powered!): 29 * 8 = 232 kH-months\n# - Existing cloud:\n#   3 kH (M1..24) -> 24 kH-months\n#   3 kH (M8..19) -> 12 kH-months\n#   3 kH (M9..20) -> 15 kH-months\n#   Total existing = 232 + 51 = 283 kH-months!\n# Gap in M16..23 BEFORE new purchases:\n# - If 7%: 501 - 283 = 218 kH-months (27.25 kH/mo!)\n# - If 3%: 437 - 283 = 154 kH-months (19.25 kH/mo!)\n\n# Now suppose in Month 12 we:\n# 1. Order 10k Gen N from Vendor ($400M? Wait: cash is $330.4M! Credit line $500M -> max spend $830M!).\n#    Wait: why order 10k Gen N all at once vs 6k now ($240M) + more in M13-15 as +$40M/mo arrives (saving 2%/mo debt interest)?\n#    YES!! Because FIFO queue only ships ~1.5k N/mo (tight) or ~4k N/mo (loose)!\n#    If we order 6k Gen N from Vendor ($240M) in M12:\n#      - At 1.5k/mo tight, 6k takes 4 months (M14..17 -> usable M15..18)!\n#      - At 4k/mo loose, 6k takes 2 months (M14..15 -> usable M15..16)!\n#      - Leaves $90.4M cash! We can order MORE Gen N in M13..15 without paying unnecessary 2%/mo interest in M12..13!\n# 2. Order 3k (or 4k) Gen N from Broker A ($132M or $176M):\n#    - Wait: if we order 6k Vendor ($240M) + 3k Broker A ($132M) = $372M -> puts cash at -$41.6M (debt interest only ~$0.8M/mo)!\n#    - Or 5k Vendor ($200M) + 3k Broker A ($132M) = $332M (nearly $0 debt!) -> usable M14 (6 kH from Broker A!) + M15..17 (10 kH from Vendor!) = 16 kH!\n#    - Wait: what if Broker A decayed in M8..15? Look: Broker A JUST DELIVERED #5 (placed M10, delivered M11)! That means Broker A was reliable at M10..11! Could it still decay in M12..15? P(decay in 12..15 | didn't decay yet) ~ 20%!\n# 3. Reserve cloud 12m in M12 (`reserve 4 12` -> 3 kH if tight, M13..24 at $1.765M/mo -> +24 kH-months in M16..23)!\n# 4. Contract power! Wait: 29k H (40.6 MW) + 15k N (24 MW) = 64.6 MW!\n#    In M20..23 we drop to 50 MW, so we need +15 to +20 MW by M20 (sign 16 MW now in M12 -> energises M15..20!).\n\nprint(\"\\nLet's compute M16..23 capacity if we get:\")\nprint(\"  - 5k Vendor N (usable M15..18 -> say 10 kH avg in M16..18, full 10 kH in M19..23)\")\nprint(\"  - + another 6k Vendor N ordered M13..15 (usable M18..22)\")\nprint(\"  - 3k Broker A N ordered M12 (usable M14..23 -> 6 kH * 8 = 48 kH-mo)\")\nprint(\"  - 3k Cloud M13..24 (24 kH-mo) + 3k Cloud M14..25 (24 kH-mo) + 3k Cloud M16..21/23 (24 kH-mo)\")\n# Tight vendor N ordered M12..18: ships M14..20 (usable M15..21):\n#   M15: 3kH, M16: 6kH, M17: 9kH, M18: 12kH, M19: 15kH, M20: 18kH, M21: 21kH, M22: 24kH, M23: 27kH\n#   Sum in M16..23 = 6+9+12+15+18+21+24+27 = 132 kH-months!\n# + Broker A 3k N (M12 -> M14): 6*8 = 48 kH-months!\n# + 1 cloud reserved M12 (M13..24): 3*8 = 24 kH-months!\n# + 1 cloud reserved M13 (M14..25): 3*8 = 24 kH-months!\n# Total M16..23 = 283 + 132 + 48 + 24 + 24 = 511 kH-months!!\nprint(\"  Total with Vendor N (continuous 1.5k/mo) + 3k Broker A N + two 3k clouds = 511 kH-months (EXCEEDS 501 even at 7%!!)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m12_opt.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m12_opt.py","time":{"start":1794668366598,"end":1794668366601}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da920b02001Ij3wnI4xg8n2gl","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da91c205001ctl7n3vyugA4Zn"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668413356,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"VClYaWPy6W4peHQj","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"# Compare financing-adjusted cost of Gen N (vendor/broker) vs Cloud vs Spot for M16..23!\n# Suppose we are in M13..M23. Cash inflows = +40/mo, baseline outflows = ~34/mo -> +6/mo surplus!\n# So ANY new GPU purchase ($40M per 1k = $20M per kH) goes onto the credit line (2%/month interest!)\n# until end of M23!\n\n# Wait: what is the residual value of 1k Gen N at Month 24?\n# Launch was M12 -> at Month 24 (12 months since launch):\n# 40 * (0.98 ** 12) * 0.75 = $23.54M per 1k = $11.77M per kH!\n\n# Suppose we buy 1k Gen N ($40M = $20M/kH) in Month m (m=13..18), usable from Month m+3..23 (or longer if queued):\nprint(\"Gen N financed at 2%/mo interest (launch M12 -> residual $11.77M/kH):\")\nfor order_m in [13, 14, 15, 16, 17]:\n    for usable_m in [order_m + 3, order_m + 4]:\n        if usable_m > 23: continue\n        months_held = 24 - order_m # interest paid for months order_m..23\n        # Compound interest at 2%/mo on $20M/kH (approx, since cash isn't paying down principal much):\n        interest = 20.0 * ((1.02 ** months_held) - 1.0)\n        net_capex = 20.0 - 11.77\n        total_cost = net_capex + interest\n        useful_mos = 24 - usable_m\n        print(f\"  Order M{order_m}, usable M{usable_m}..23 ({useful_mos} mos): net_capex=${net_capex:.2f}M + int=${interest:.2f}M = ${total_cost:.2f}M -> ${total_cost/useful_mos:.2f}M/kH-mo (excl new power)\")\n\nprint(\"\\nCompare Cloud contracts (zero upfront debt, paid monthly!):\")\n# In M13: 12m = $1.848M/mo (M14..25 -> 10 useful M14..23, or 8 in M16..23) -> 1.848*12/10 = $2.22M/useful-mo (or $2.77M/M16..23-mo!)\n# In M15 (assuming +4%/mo tight): 12m index ~$2.00M, 6m = $2.30M/mo (M16..21 -> ALL 6 useful! {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794668444252,"sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"aENaF0ZcDW8zXYMl","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/m14_opt.py","content":"# Exact Month 14..23 Run 3 planning!\n# Already owned / committed for M16..23:\n# 1. Owned H: 29.00k (needs 40.6 MW)\n# 2. Owned N: 4.00k = 8 kH (needs 6.4 MW)\n# 3. Vendor N #7 in queue: 4.00k = 8 kH (ships ~M14..16 if tight, M14 if loose -> all 8 kH usable M17..23, ~4-6 kH in M16!)\n#    Needs 6.4 MW -> Total power for 29k H + 8k N = 40.6 + 12.8 = 53.4 MW!\n#    Power active:\n#      M15..19: 82 MW (plenty! 28.6 MW free = 17.8k N!)\n#      M20..23: 66 MW (12.6 MW free = 7.875k N!)\n# 4. Cloud contracts already committed:\n#    - 3 kH (M1..24) -> 24 kH-mo in M16..23\n#    - 3 kH (M8..19) -> 12 kH-mo in M16..19\n#    - 3 kH (M9..20) -> 15 kH-mo in M16..20\n#    - 3 kH (M13..24) -> 24 kH-mo in M16..23\n#    Total existing cloud in M16..23 = 75 kH-months!\n\n# Sum ALREADY committed in M16..23 (assuming tight 1.5k/mo on #7 -> M15: 3kH, M16: 6kH, M17..23: 8kH):\nh_m16_23 = 29 * 8 # 232\nn_broker_m16_23 = 8 * 8 # 64\nn_vend7_m16_23 = 6 + 8*7 # 62 (or 64 if loose)\ncloud_existing = 75\nbase_total = h_m16_23 + n_broker_m16_23 + n_vend7_m16_23 + cloud_existing\nprint(f\"Already committed M16..23: H={h_m16_23} + N_brk={n_broker_m16_23} + N_v7={n_vend7_m16_23} + cloud={cloud_existing} = {base_total} kH-months!\")\n\n# Inference M16..23 projections from M13=12.32:\n# Case A: switched to 3% (from ~12.32 at M13):\ninf_3 = [12.32 * (1.03 ** (m - 13)) for m in range(16, 24)]\n# Case B: still 7% (from ~12.32 at M13, or ~13.0 trend at M13):\ninf_7 = [12.8 * (1.07 ** (m - 13)) for m in range(16, 24)]\nprint(f\"Target M16..23 (3% from 12.32): 320 + {sum(inf_3):.1f} = {320 + sum(inf_3):.1f} -> GAP = {320 + sum(inf_3) - base_total:.1f} kH-months\")\nprint(f\"Target M16..23 (7% from 12.80): 320 + {sum(inf_7):.1f} = {320 + sum(inf_7):.1f} -> GAP = {320 + sum(inf_7) - base_total:.1f} kH-months\")\n\n# Compare options to fill a ~80 kH-month gap (safe for BOTH 3% and 7%!):\n# Option 1: Order 4k Gen N from Broker A in M14 -> usable M16..23 (8 months * 8 kH = 64 kH-months)!\n#   Wait: cost = $176M (borrowed at 2%/mo for 10 months M14..23!).\n#   Interest = 176 * (1.02^10 - 1) = $38.54M (or less since +$6M/mo cash surplus pays down a bit, say ~$35M!)\n#   Net capex = $176M - 4*23.54 ($94.16M) = $81.84M.\n#   Total cost = $81.84M + $35M = $116.84M (uses FREE existing power!) / 64 kH-months = $1.83M / kH-month!\n#   Wait: what if Broker A decayed in M14 (cancel -> loses 20% = $35.2M)?!\n# Option 2: Order 4k (or 6k) Gen N from Vendor in M14 -> 0% cancel risk, $40M/1k = $160M!\n#   Wait: if tight, #7 (4k) ships M14 (1.5k), M15 (1.5k), M16 (1.0k) -> finishes M16!\n#   So new Vendor N ordered in M14 ships M16 (0.5k), M17 (1.5k), M18 (1.5k), M19 (0.5k) -> usable M17..23!\n#   If we order 4k Vendor N ($160M) in M14 (or 3k in M14, 3k in M16):\n#   Let's check capacity of 4k Vendor N arriving M17..20:\n#     M17: 1kH, M18: 4kH, M19: 7kH, M20..23: 8kH*4=32 -> 1+4+7+32 = 44 kH-months!\n#   Plus 2k more ordered later (M21: 3kH, M22..23: 4kH*2=8 -> +11 kH-months) = 55 kH-months!\n# Option 3: Reserve 6m Cloud in M15, M16, M17 (3 kH each * 6 mos = 18 kH-mo each = 54 kH-months total!):\n#   Cost: ~$2.10-$2.30M/kH-month, ZERO debt interest, ZERO cancel risk, ZERO power needed, ZERO residual risk!\n#   Wait: check cash flow with 3 more 3kH clouds (~$6.5M*3 = +$19.5M/mo -> wait: total monthly outflow would be $34M + $19.5M = $53.5M/mo vs +$40M funding -> -$13.5M/mo cash, NO big upfront debt!).\n\nprint(\"\\nCompare Option 1 (Broker A 4k N) vs Option 2 (Vendor 4k N) vs Option 3 (6m Cloud in M15..17):\")\n# Vendor 4k N ordered M15 (Wait: #7 isn't done until M16! So ordering Vendor N in M15 instead of M14 saves 1 mo interest on $160M = $3.2M and loses ZERO delivery time!):\n# Let's check interest on $160M ordered M15 for M15..23 (9 mos): 160 * (1.02^9 - 1) = $31.2M\n# Net capex = 160 - 94.16 = $65.84M -> total = $97.0M for 44 kH-months = $2.20M/kH-month!\nprint(\"  Vendor 4k N ordered M15 (44 kH-mo in M17..23): ~$2.20M/kH-mo (0% cancel risk, free power!)\")\nprint(\"  6m Cloud in M15..17 (54 kH-mo in M16..23): ~$2.15-$2.35M/kH-mo (0% cancel risk, 0 debt, 100% flexible to M15..17 inference!)\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/m14_opt.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/m14_opt.py","time":{"start":1794668444247,"end":1794668444249}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da933a53001w5XlgUEkDtJDhP","sessionID":"ses_e2580d748ffe1pSBh2aqZMJZnO","messageID":"msg_1da930bcf001n9ti2GQWTdrgir"}}
